name: reagent
description: Reagent protocol language — compiler, reference runtimes, and tooling

scripts.build: npm run build:lang && npm run build:runtime
scripts.compile:examples: for f in examples/protocols/src/*.rg; do node lang/dist/cli.js compile "$f" "examples/out/$(basename "$f" .rg)"; done
scripts.test:lang: npm run test:lang:surface && npm run test:lang:compiler
scripts.test:fast: npm run test:lang:surface && npm run test:runtime:fast
scripts.test:default: npm run test:fast && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:stories
scripts.test:all: npm run test:lang && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:runtime:cluster && npm run test:stories && npm run test:stories:nats && npm run test:stories:debug && npm run test:stories:live && npm run test:tooling:lsp
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test:default
scripts.check:all: npm run build && npm run test:all
scripts.validate:examples: for f in examples/protocols/src/*.rg; do node lang/dist/cli.js validate "$f"; done
